properties.name: items
properties.description:
The full item pool — both columns are derived from it.

Accepts the array (property) or a **JSON string** (attribute), so a
plain-HTML page can declare its data inline instead of reaching for a
script. Malformed JSON degrades to an empty list with a console warning.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Values currently in the *target* (right) column.

properties.name: sourceTitle
properties.description: Title for the source side.

properties.name: targetTitle
properties.description: Title for the target side.

properties.name: searchable
properties.description: Render search inputs above each list.

properties.name: sourceSearchPlaceholder
properties.description: Source-side search placeholder.

properties.name: targetSearchPlaceholder
properties.description: Target-side search placeholder.

properties.name: showSelectAll
properties.description: Show the "select all" select-all checkbox in each header.

properties.name: searchIcon
properties.description: Material Symbols glyph for the search fields' leading icon ('' = none).

properties.name: moveRightIcon
properties.description: Material Symbols glyph for the "move selected to target" (>) button.

properties.name: moveLeftIcon
properties.description: Material Symbols glyph for the "move selected to source" (<) button.

properties.name: moveAllRightIcon
properties.description: Material Symbols glyph for the "move all to target" (>>) button.

properties.name: moveAllLeftIcon
properties.description: Material Symbols glyph for the "move all to source" (<<) button.

properties.name: emptyIcon
properties.description: Optional Material Symbols glyph shown above the empty-state text.

properties.name: emptyText
properties.description: Empty-state text (localisable).

properties.name: countTemplate
properties.description:
Template for the header count pill (localisable). `{checked}` and
`{total}` are replaced with the live numbers.

properties.name: density
properties.description: Density scale: 0 (default), -1, -2, -3, -4. Passed to the search text field.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disable the entire control.

properties.name: singleStepOnly
properties.description: Show only the >/< buttons (drop >>/<< "move all").

properties.name: moveRightLabel
properties.description:
Accessible label for the > button (localisable). NB: deliberately NOT an
`aria-*`-prefixed attribute — a custom attribute in the aria namespace is
invalid ARIA (axe aria-valid-attr).

properties.name: moveLeftLabel
properties.description: Accessible label for the < button (localisable).

properties.name: moveAllRightLabel
properties.description: Accessible label for the >> button (localisable).

properties.name: moveAllLeftLabel
properties.description: Accessible label for the << button (localisable).

properties.name: selectAllLabel
properties.description:
Accessible label for each header's select-all checkbox (localisable).
`{title}` is replaced with that column's title.

cssProperties.description: Row plate inset from the panel edge

name: Transfer List
description: A dual-list selector. Two columns — source and target — with per-side search, select-all headers, checkbox rows, and four movers between them. The value prop is the set of item values currently in the target column.

notes: Dedicated native transfer list: all 24 properties (items as an array or its JSON string, controlled value, titles, searchable with placeholders and icon, select-all with its label template, the four movers' icons and labels, the empty state's icon and text, the count template, density, disabled, single-step-only), both events (mdChange string[], mdMove {direction, moved, target}) and both methods (moveSelectedRight/moveSelectedLeft through AWCTransferListController), with the twenty --md-transfer-list-* hooks as a typed appearance API (item padding as the CSS padding shorthand's physical sides). The host attributes full-width/full-height are read as the fullWidth/fullHeight properties, as on md-card.

Layout is the source's CSS grid: 1fr auto 1fr with the gap, a minmax(0, 1fr) row that is the host's block size, searchable columns at the definite 360px cap (or the height hook; 100% with full-height) overflowing a shorter row, the others stretched up to the cap, the movers stretched to the row; the stacked layout at a viewport of 640 or less with rotated movers; RTL mirrors the movers. The count pill uses Roboto advances with the 0.4px letter spacing.

Interaction as in the source: a row click or Space/Enter toggles its check (checks per side in check order, dropped when a controlled value or items change takes the item away), select-all of the visible enabled rows, per-side search over label and description, movers on the visible enabled checked rows; a press focuses the row without the ring (Chrome's :focus-visible), keys show it; the row checkbox is inert (out of the focus order, presses go to the row); a disabled list keeps its scroll region focusable.

Motion: row backgrounds transition 100 ms ease in premultiplied Oklab (CSS colour interpolation), starting at the frame the change renders; the md-ripple wave paints under the row's checkbox; reduced motion removes the transition.

Typed ::part() targets (AWCTransferListPartAppearance, one AWCTransferListPartStyle per part): column and, per side, column-source / column-target (background, border colour, corner radius; a side's values over column's), header (background, the divider under it), header-title (background), count (background, text colour, corner radius), search (background of the field's padded box), list (background), item (background, which replaces the hover / checked / focus layers as a ::part() declaration does; corner radius of the row, its focus ring and ripple), empty (background, text and icon colour), empty-icon (colour, size, opacity), controls (background). Part values come from the outer tree, so they win over the hooks and every state rule. Verified against Chrome 153's ::part() cases (web-oracle/parts.json).
